verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents its own self-hosted deployment, into any Kubernetes cluster or anywhere Docker runs, and a community user confirms self-hosting. That lets a user decide where the pipeline and its data physically reside. However, no documentation explicitly addresses data residency or region selection, and nothing shows Airbyte Cloud offering region choice. missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region-selection docs, Cloud region choice, residency guarantees or compliance statements.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This installation guide walks through how to deploy Airbyte into any kubernetes cluster.
abctl makes it easy to run Airbyte anywhere Docker is running.
We use airbyte at my company, although we self-host it.
